images.caption: Alternate cover — black-and-white copperplate engraving
images.style_prompt: Black-and-white copperplate engraving in the manner of an 18th-century scientific engraving, purely pictorial: a steep forested mountain overlooking a coastal city and harbor; hikers strain upward on a long stairway cut into the slope while a gondola glides effortlessly up its cables beside them; both routes converge on the same radiant summit crowned with light; fine cross-hatching throughout.

images.caption: Alternate cover — vintage travel poster
images.style_prompt: Vintage screen-printed travel poster with flat retro colors and bold simple shapes, purely pictorial: a steep green forested mountain rising above a coastal harbor city, hikers climbing a long winding stairway cut into the slope while a red gondola glides up cables beside them, both routes converging on a sunny summit under a bright sky.
